titleEn: Count Negative Numbers in a Sorted Matrix
title: 统计有序矩阵中的负数
summary: 矩阵每行、每列都按非递增顺序排列，统计所有负数数量。
insight: 从右上角开始：若当前值为负，则该列从当前行到末行都为负，累加 rows-row 并左移；否则下移寻找更小值。
pitfalls: 每次可批量计一列的后缀

solutions.title: 右上角阶梯扫描
solutions.idea: 利用行列单调性一次排除一行或统计一列。

code.java: class Solution { public int countNegatives(int[][] grid){int rows=grid.length,row=0,column=grid[0].length-1,answer=0;while(row<rows&&column>=0)if(grid[row][column]<0){answer+=rows-row;column--;}else row++;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countNegatives(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{val rows=grid.size;var row=0;var column=grid[0].lastIndex;var answer=0;while(row<rows&&column>=0)if(grid[row][column]<0){answer+=rows-row;column--}else row++;return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int countNegatives(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int rows=grid.size(),row=0,column=grid[0].size()-1,answer=0;while(row<rows&&column>=0)if(grid[row][column]<0){answer+=rows-row;--column;}else ++row;return answer;} };
